purpose: Test a cheaper K-means-native relevance update that avoids the prior method's second full K-means fit.

one_update_formulation.initial_fit: one class-owned MiniBatchKMeans fit with four prototypes per class in raw geometry
one_update_formulation.correct_prototype: nearest prototype owned by the row label
one_update_formulation.impostor_prototype: nearest prototype owned by another label
one_update_formulation.update: exactly one within-class weighted reassignment followed by one arithmetic centroid update
one_update_formulation.heldout: fixed weighted centers scored with the current strict second-own versus best-target OI event definition

interpretation.success_signal: Match or improve two-stage nonlinear-nuisance ranking with materially lower runtime while preserving linear-nuisance and nonlinear-clean ranking.
interpretation.runtime_claim: Toy only; a real-shape anchor is required before any runtime conclusion.
